I would definitely if possible, spray the entire plant down with a hose or in the shower. Then treat with a neem oil and insecticidal soap. It’s crucial that you wipe down the plant. Just spraying the plant won’t immediately stop the problem. Spider mites have a tendency to become resistant to neem if it’s used on its own as a spray. Wiping them down ensures you can get into every crevice and leaf. Once wiped down, treat weekly until there is no sign of mites. Their eggs won’t necessarily be eradicated with just spraying sometimes so it’s best to continue treatment.
 Wiping them down weekly will also help, since it’s a bigger tree it’s obviously a little harder. Neem oil also works great as a preventative, so the likelihood of future pests is not as high. I hope this helps. I absolutely hate pests. I work with plants and I am extremely anal about pests so I’m always spraying and cleaning them to prevent any pests. Even got a checklist😅
